definitions.short: a travelling pouch (as if for gleanings)
definitions.full: H3219. yalqut יַלְקוּט noun [masculine] receptacle, wallet (?) (properly collector ) (on form compare Lag BN p.127 Ba NB § 156 b Kö ii.1, § 76, 4 ) — only in 1Sam 17:40 and he put them [the stones] וּבַיַּלְקוּט אֲשֶׁרלֿוֺ הָרֹעִים בִּכְלִי in the shepherd's receptacle which he had, even (?) in the wallet (? such as every shepherd carried, hence article); but probably strike out ו before ׳בַּיַּל ( ᵐ5 The We Klo Bu HPS), and regard לוֺ ֗֗֗ בִּכְלְי as gloss (We Bu HPS).

occurrences.englishText: He took his staff in his hand, and chose for himself five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag which he had. His sling was in his hand; and he came near to the Philistine.
